# ===================================================================
# BAD MISSING LOCALIZATION KEYS
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates events referencing localization keys that
# do NOT exist in any .yml file in the mod.
#
# Error Code Demonstrated:
# - CK4100: Missing localization key
#
# Expected validation result: ERRORS DETECTED (CK4100 for each missing key)
# ===================================================================

# ERROR CK4100

namespace = missing_loc_test

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# ERROR CK4100: Event with non-existent localization keys
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Detection of title/desc/name referencing loc keys
# that don't exist in any .yml localization file.
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK4100 for title, desc, and option name
# WHY IT'S BAD: Missing localization means blank text in-game
# HOW TO FIX: Define the keys in a localization .yml file
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
missing_loc_test.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = missing_loc_test.0001.t
	desc = missing_loc_test.0001.desc
	theme = intrigue

	option = {
		name = missing_loc_test.0001.a
	}
}
